statements: ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.agent_registry ADD COLUMN registry_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), ADD COLUMN source_id text REFERENCES public.sources(id), ADD COLUMN actor_key text, ADD COLUMN revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, ADD COLUMN created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.agent_registry DROP CONSTRAINT agent_registry_pkey, ADD PRIMARY KEY(registry_id), ADD CONSTRAINT agent_registry_scoped_key UNIQUE(source_id,actor_key,agent_id), ADD CONSTRAINT agent_registry_scope_pair CHECK ((source_id IS NULL)=(actor_key IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT agent_registry_owner_shape CHECK (actor_key IS NULL OR actor_key ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT agent_registry_revision_positive CHECK (revision>0)

ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories ADD COLUMN source_id text REFERENCES public.sources(id), ADD COLUMN actor_key text, ADD COLUMN visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private', ADD COLUMN revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, ADD COLUMN last_confirmed timestamptz
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories ALTER COLUMN confidence DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN confidence DROP DEFAULT

ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories ADD CONSTRAINT personal_scope_pair CHECK ((source_id IS NULL)=(actor_key IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT personal_owner_shape CHECK (actor_key IS NULL OR actor_key ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT personal_visibility CHECK (visibility IN ('private','source')), ADD CONSTRAINT personal_revision_positive CHECK (revision>0), ADD CONSTRAINT personal_scoped_agent FOREIGN KEY(source_id,actor_key,agent_id) REFERENCES ultrabrain.agent_registry(source_id,actor_key,agent_id)

ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories ADD CONSTRAINT personal_scoped_payload CHECK (source_id IS NULL OR (type IN ('identity','preference','environment','project','decision','skill','error','goal','experience') AND status IN ('candidate','active','archived') AND importance IN ('low','normal','high') AND (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence>=0 AND confidence<=1)) AND content_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 AND agent_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.personal_events (source_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sources(id),actor_key text NOT NULL CHECK(actor_key ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),event_id text NOT NULL CHECK(event_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,96}$'),operation text NOT NULL,request_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(request_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),result jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(result)='object'),created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),PRIMARY KEY(source_id,actor_key,event_id))
